programme_name: Máster Universitario en Desarrollo y Operaciones (DevOps)
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — RUCT 4317664, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', Máster RD 822/2021, MECES 3, verificación 22/01/2021, BOE 27/07/2021 and 11/08/2021, centro: Escuela Superior de Ingeniería y Tecnología (26004007). The only official pure-DevOps master registered in Spain.
spring_intake: NOT FOUND — CONFLICT in indexed evidence; see notes. Not recordable as YES on primary evidence.
start_date_verbatim: Search index of https://www.unir.net/ingenieria/master-devops/ returns the programme status bar as: 'Inicio 2 nov 2026 | Duración 1 curso | Créditos 60 ECTS | Modalidad Online interactivo | Exámenes Online y/o presenciales | Título Oficial'. A second index pass on the same page returned the sentence 'The current call starts on March 16, 2026'. The two cannot be reconciled from the index alone.
start_month: November (2 Nov 2026) per the indexed status bar. A March/April date is asserted by a second index pass and by UNIR's institution-level 'convocatoria primavera' marketing, but NOT confirmed on the programme page.
intakes_per_year: NOT FOUND for this title. UNIR institution-wide is documented in wave 1 as running staggered convocatorias with NO September intake; a UNIR 'convocatoria primavera 2026' is reported by third parties (mundoposgrado, federacionastronomica.es) but no UNIR page could be fetched to confirm a spring START for this master.
modality: online ('Online interactivo'; exams 'Online y/o presenciales') — indexed status bar
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND on a fetchable primary page (page 403s). UNIR ingeniería masters are taught in castellano; not verified here.
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND — per the shared brief, UNIR publishes no price for any master and any figure without a non-UNIR primary source is unsupported.
evidence_verbatim: 'Inicio 2 nov 2026 | Duración 1 curso | Créditos 60 ECTS | Modalidad Online interactivo | Exámenes Online y/o presenciales | Título Oficial' (search-index rendering of the programme page status bar)
notes: ⛔ SOURCE PROVENANCE: source_access = 'search index — page returns 403 (Cloudflare), not directly fetched'. Verified this pass: www.unir.net, usa.unir.net, mexico.unir.net AND static.unir.net all return 403 to curl with a browser UA, and www.unir.net returns 403 to WebFetch. The one static.unir.net asset that did fetch (https://static.unir.net/documentos/Master-Devops-bloques-estudio.pdf) is a brochure for a DIFFERENT, older UNIR product — the título propio 'Máster en DevOps, Cloud Computing y Automatización de Producción de Software' (6-ECTS blocks: Cloud Computing/DevOps Culture, Administración de Sistemas para la Cloud, Fundamentos de Redes para Cloud, Gestión de Proyectos, Herramientas DevOps) — and carries NO dates. Do not confuse the two products. ECTS 60 (48 obligatorios + 12 TFM, 0 optativos, 0 prácticas) is PRIMARY-SOURCED from the RUCT detail page, not from the index. Complementos formativos: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT. ⚠️ NEEDS A HUMAN TO OPEN https://www.unir.net/ingenieria/master-devops/ IN A NORMAL BROWSER and read the 'Inicio' field — this is the single highest-value unresolved question in path AC, because if UNIR's DevOps master does run a spring convocatoria it is the only OFFICIAL pure-DevOps spring start in Spain.

institution: Mondragon Unibertsitatea — Escuela Politécnica Superior, Arrasate-Mondragón (Gipuzkoa)
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Análisis de Datos, Ciberseguridad y Computación en la Nube (the site's own page <title> now reads 'Máster Universitario en Análisis de Datos, Ciberseguridad, y Desarrollo y Operaciones.' — see notes)
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — RUCT 4316970, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', Máster RD 822/2021, MECES 3, rama Ingeniería y Arquitectura, verificación 05/06/2019, BOE 17/12/2019, 06/05/2021 and 25/12/2025, acreditación institucional favorable 21/10/2024.
start_date_verbatim: No spring start. The admission page publishes ONE annual cycle ending in a single July enrolment: 'A partir de febrero habrá cuatro fechas de preadmisión en el máster: 24/02/2026, 24/03/2026, 05/05/2026, 16/06/2026'; admission decisions issued in July; ordinary matrícula window '10/07/2026 — 15/07/2026'.
start_month: NOT STATED on the page as a date, but structurally September/autumn — the cycle runs Nov 2025 → July 2026 matrícula for one cohort.
intakes_per_year: 1 (one cohort). The FOUR February–June dates are PREADMISSION ROUNDS, not cohort starts — exactly the distinction the brief warns about.
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: N/A — no spring intake exists. Final preadmisión round for the 2026-27 cohort: 16/06/2026; matrícula 10–15/07/2026.
language_of_instruction: 'Castellano, Inglés' — both, per the programme page
tuition_total_eur: EUR 10,920 for 60 ECTS of one academic year (the title is 90 ECTS over 1.5 years, so the full-programme figure is NOT the same as this and is NOT PUBLISHED on the page — do not multiply without a source). Reservation deposit 8% = EUR 873.60. Rates as published on the 2026-27 admission page.
evidence_verbatim: 'A partir de febrero habrá cuatro fechas de preadmisión en el máster: 24/02/2026, 24/03/2026, 05/05/2026, 16/06/2026' · ordinary matrícula '10/07/2026 — 15/07/2026'
notes: ⭐ TITLE CHANGE WORTH FLAGGING: Mondragon's own site serves this programme under two names. The body/H1 still reads 'Análisis de Datos, Ciberseguridad y Computación en la Nube' (matching RUCT 4316970), but the page <title> as indexed reads 'Máster Universitario en Análisis de Datos, Ciberseguridad, y Desarrollo y Operaciones.' — i.e. the cloud strand appears to have been rebadged as DevOps. RUCT records a BOE entry dated 25/12/2025, consistent with a recent modificación. If that rename is real, this is the SECOND official Spanish master carrying 'Desarrollo y Operaciones' in its name alongside UNIR 4317664 — but it is NOT a spring-start programme either way. RUCT credits: 90 total = 48 obligatorios + 27 optativos + 15 TFM; complementos formativos NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT.

institution: Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha (UCLM) — Escuela Superior de Informática (Ciudad Real) and Escuela Superior de Ingeniería Informática (Albacete)
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Big Data y Computación en la Nube (MUBDCN)
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — RUCT 3500731, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E.', Máster RD 822/2021, MECES 3, rama Ingeniería y Arquitectura, campo Ingeniería informática y de sistemas, verificación 26/05/2025, BOE 01/10/2025 and 20/10/2025. A new title, first taught 2025/26.
start_date_verbatim: The MUBDCN microsite publishes exactly one annual cycle for curso 2026-2027: 'Preinscripción: 24 de marzo al 11 de septiembre de 2026' · 'Admisión: 24 de marzo al 18 de septiembre de 2026' · 'Matrícula: 23 de junio al 30 de septiembre de 2026'. '60 créditos ECTS repartidos en 1 curso académico'. No February and no second-semester entry is mentioned anywhere on the page.
start_month: NOT STATED as a date; structurally autumn — matrícula closes 30 September 2026 for the 2026-27 course.
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: N/A — no spring intake. (2026-27 autumn cycle: preinscripción closes 11/09/2026.)
modality: virtual — 'Modalidad virtual, sin necesidad de presencialidad en la mayor parte de sesiones'; mix of synchronous online sessions and asynchronous work; in-person attendance only for the TFM defence.
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND — not stated on the MUBDCN microsite.
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND — not published on the microsite.
evidence_verbatim: 'Preinscripción: 24 de marzo al 11 de septiembre de 2026' · 'Admisión: 24 de marzo al 18 de septiembre de 2026' · 'Matrícula: 23 de junio al 30 de septiembre de 2026' · '60 créditos ECTS repartidos en 1 curso académico'
notes: The brief's carried note that UCLM preinscription read 'cerrada por plazas cubiertas' refers to an earlier cycle; as at access date the 2026-27 window is published as open from 24/03/2026. ⚠️ The March start of the PREINSCRIPTION window is precisely the pattern the spring brief warns against — it is an application window opening in spring, NOT a spring cohort start. Confirms the shared brief's subdomain guidance: www.uclm.es 403s but esi.uclm.es serves normally (both the MUBDCN microsite and the ESI news post fetched fine). ESI's sibling masters MUII (Ingeniería Informática, 90 ECTS, virtual) and MUIA (Inteligencia Artificial, 60 ECTS, virtual) share the same single 24/03–11/09/2026 preinscription window, so the NO verdict is school-wide, not title-specific. RUCT credits: 60 = 48 obligatorios + 6 optativos + 6 TFM; complementos formativos NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT.
